_comment: BibleLive transcription benchmark corpus manifest. Copy to benchmarks/corpus/manifest.json (not committed if you prefer), or keep beside recordings you may share. Audio files are NOT committed; point BIBLELIVE_BENCH_AUDIO_DIR at their local directory.

recordings.source: describe the authorized origin (e.g. self-recorded test sermon, licensed archive, public-domain recording)
recordings.sha256: hex digest of the local audio file (fill with benchmarks/hash_audio.py or sha256sum)
recordings.speaking_rate_note: free-text: e.g. slow measured, fast with quick reference mentions
recordings.notes: limitations of source captions here, if any
